names.name: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo

summary: Crime novel by the Swedish writer Stieg Larsson in which a journalist and a hacker, Lisbeth Salander, investigate a decades-old disappearance. It began the Millennium series, which sold in the tens of millions.
